name: LOVELY QUEST
source:
Summer is the season of love. There have been many cases of ‘impure’ relationships at Academy Amanotogawa and the “Lovely Smile Committee” was started to promote ‘pure’ love. But what is pure love? Is holding hands after school ‘pure’? What about feeding a homemade bentou, giving a lap pillow or going to the bath together? Zenichi was chosen to be the lone member on the committee and sets out to search for true pure love. There’s no time to be embarrassed, the future of the school has been entrusted to you.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
